title: Paying & Complaints
npcIntro: What happens when things go sideways — and you still want to be polite.
npcOutro: Complaint handled, dignity intact. Well done.

exercises.prompt: There's a hair in your latte. Which complaint is most polite?
choices: Excuse me, I'm afraid there's a hair in my drink.
exercises.phraseCard: I'm afraid there's a hair in my drink.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence uses 'tip' correctly as a verb?
choices: I tipped the waiter twenty percent.
I tipped to the waiter twenty percent.
I made the waiter a tip of twenty percent.
I gave a tip the waiter twenty percent.

exercises.prompt: Pick the correct conditional: "If I ____ known the wait was that long, I ____ somewhere else."
exercises.phraseCard: third conditional: had + p.p. / would have + p.p.
Could we split the bill three ways, please?

exercises.prompt: You hear: "Just keep the change." — what is the customer doing?
choices: Letting the server keep the leftover money as a tip.
Asking the server to bring back the exact change.
exercises.phraseCard: Keep the change (= treat the leftover as a tip)
